title: 第二十三章 叶寒梅的心思第二十四章 剑意一层
content_zh:
第二十三章：叶寒梅的心思苏家大门外，赵家众人神气而来，狼狈离去。
扭头看了一眼身后庄重大气的苏家府邸，赵月如脸色冰冷怨毒。
“苏命，你今日给我的屈辱，他日，我绝对会在你身上找回来。”
赵明长叹一口，拉着一把赵月如的手道：“走吧，现在的苏命不光修为恢复了，而且还跟天剑宗的长老勾搭在了一起，咱们赵家小门小派，拿什么跟他斗？”
“要我说，当初要不是你执意要退婚，现在我赵家就不会有这么一个仇敌，反而会多出一个乘龙快婿。”
“爹！你怎么可以说这种话！”赵月如一脸悲愤道：“苏命刚刚怎么侮辱我们的你都忘了吗？”
“是，他现在的确是小人得志了。可苏权哥哥明日就到了，苏命杀了苏权哥哥两个舅舅，还废了他母亲，苏权哥哥一定不会放过他的。”
赵月如眼底跳动着怨毒之色，其实在亲眼看到苏命的实力之后，有那么一瞬间，她也在为自己的决定后悔。
如今的苏命，要实力有实力，要家世有家世，颜值，更是世间少有……
但很快，她就将这种想法死死压在心底，她是潜龙城最美的美人，还是赵家的嫡女，她心中的骄傲不允许她后悔。她更不想承认是自己错了。
“我一定没做错决定，只有苏权哥哥，才是我最佳的良配！”
……
苏家，柳家柳关山身死道消，赵家众人悻悻离去，仅剩的王家也识趣地寻了个由头离开。
大殿内，此刻就只剩下苏家众人和叶寒梅师徒。
吩咐众人将大殿洒扫干净，又命人将柳媚儿带了下去。
苏然对着胡常然恭敬道：“前辈远道而来，今日之事，实在是让两位见笑了……”
胡常然淡淡摆手：“老夫说了，苏命对我徒弟有救命之恩，今日能替他解围，也算是老夫回报了他一个恩情。”
面对其他人，胡常然的态度就变得高冷了许多。
苏然也意识到了这一点，笑了笑没再说话。
一旁，叶寒梅对着胡常然挤眉弄眼，低声道：“师父，我跟你说的那件事……”

胡常然深深看了苏命一眼，而后对着叶寒梅传音道：
“这小子的确是如你所说，天赋过人，收他为徒自然是可以。可是，他的战力已接近金丹极致，为师这才天门境三层的修为，能教他的实在是不多啊。”
“那怎么办？”
“傻丫头，你是不是糊涂了，我虽然不行，可是你父亲行啊。”
“啊！我父亲？”叶寒梅的脸上顿时露出一副欲言又止的模样：“您也知道我父亲，他眼界奇高，我还是他亲生女儿他都不乐意教，更别说外人了。一般人他是不会放在眼里的，我是担心……”
“无妨无妨！”胡常然捻了一把胡须道：“以他的天资，应当足够！”
苏命将两人的传音交流看在眼里，但他却丝毫不在意。
起身对着二人拱了拱手，苏命沉声道：
“两位若是不嫌弃，大可以在我苏家歇息，我还有些事情要办，就先行告辞了。”
“啊，你要去哪里？”叶寒梅下意识站了起来，眼巴巴地看着苏命，似乎极为舍不得。
苏然和胡常然都是过来人，一眼就看出了叶寒梅对苏命态度的不一般。
两人对视一眼，又默契地低下头，不知道各自心中在想什么。
苏命淡淡道：“明日苏权就要回来了，我和他之间注定无法善了，因此在这之前。我必须尽可能再强一些。”
他语气淡漠，但还是忍不住多看了几眼面前容颜绝美的叶寒梅。
content_en:
Chapter 23: Ye Hanmei's Thoughts Outside the Su family's gate, everyone from the Zhao family came in awe and left in embarrassment.
Turning her head to look at the solemn Su family mansion behind her, Zhao Yueru's expression was cold and vicious.
"Su Ming, I will definitely get back the humiliation you gave me today."
Zhao Ming sighed, took Zhao Yueru's hand and said, "Let's go. Now Su Ming has not only recovered his cultivation, but has also hooked up with the elders of the Tianjian Sect. What can we, the Zhao family's small sect, do to fight him?"
"Let me tell you, if you hadn't insisted on breaking off the engagement, our Zhao family would not have such an enemy now. Instead, we would have a son-in-law who can ride a dragon."
"Dad! How can you say such a thing!" Zhao Yueru said with a look of grief and anger: "Have you forgotten how Su Ming just insulted us?"
"Yes, he is indeed a villain now. But Brother Su Quan will arrive tomorrow. Su Ming killed Brother Su Quan's two uncles and deposed his mother. Brother Su Quan will definitely not let him go."
Zhao Yueru's eyes were filled with resentment. In fact, after seeing Su Ming's strength with her own eyes, she regretted her decision for a moment.
Today's Su Ming needs to have strength, family background, and good looks, which is rare in the world...
But soon, she suppressed this thought in her heart. She was the most beautiful beauty in Qianlong City and the legitimate daughter of the Zhao family. The pride in her heart did not allow her to regret it. She didn't want to admit that she was wrong.
"I must have made the right decision. Only brother Su Quan is my best match!"
…
Su family, Liu family and Liu Guanshan died, and everyone in the Zhao family left in anger. The only remaining Wang family also found an excuse to leave.
In the main hall, only the Su family and master and apprentice Ye Hanmei were left at this moment.
He ordered everyone to clean the main hall and ordered people to take Liu Meier down.
Su Ran said respectfully to Hu Changran: "Senior has come all the way, what happened today really made you two laugh..."
Hu Changran waved his hand calmly: "I said that Su Ming had a life-saving grace for my apprentice. Being able to rescue him today can be regarded as my repayment of his kindness."
Facing other people, Hu Changran's attitude became much colder.
Su Ran also realized this, smiled and said no more.
On the side, Ye Hanmei winked at Hu Changran and whispered: "Master, what I told you..."
Hu Changran took a deep look at Su Ming, and then said to Ye Hanmei:
"This boy is indeed as talented as you said. It is natural to accept him as a disciple. However, his combat power is close to the ultimate golden elixir. As a teacher who is only at the third level of Tianmen Realm, there is really not much that can be taught to him."
"What should we do?"
"Silly girl, are you confused? Although I can't do it, your father can."
"Ah! My father?" Ye Hanmei's face suddenly showed a look of hesitation: "You also know that my father has a very high vision. He is not willing to teach me or his biological daughter, let alone outsiders. He will not take ordinary people seriously. I am worried..."
"It doesn't matter!" Hu Changran twirled his beard and said, "With his talent, it should be enough!"
Su Ming saw the communication between the two, but he didn't care at all.
Standing up and cupping his hands towards the two of them, Su Ming said in a deep voice:
"If you two don't mind, you can rest at my Su's house. I still have some things to do, so I'll leave first."
"Ah, where are you going?" Ye Hanmei stood up subconsciously and looked at Su Ming eagerly, as if she was extremely reluctant to part with him.
Su Ran and Hu Changran were both experienced, and they could tell at a glance Ye Hanmei's unusual attitude towards Su Ming.
The two looked at each other and lowered their heads in tacit agreement, not knowing what they were thinking.
Su Ming said calmly: "Su Quan will come back tomorrow, and there is definitely no way to get along between me and him, so before that.... I have to be as strong as possible. "
His tone was indifferent, but he couldn't help but take a few more glances at the beautiful Ye Hanmei in front of him.
